t: AUA-JM2: The AI Upgrade App JAH Model 2
title: AUA-JM2: The AI Upgrade App JAH Model 2
description: The AI Upgrade App JAH Model 2 (AUA-JM2) is presented in the inventor's 2025 award-submission notes as a novel, self-initializing, meta-algorithmic protocol that transforms any compatible AI into P_JAH, the JAH Patenting Operator. This is a Signature concept: filed as the inventor's original protocol design, not as an established AI result.
content:
The AI Upgrade App JAH Model 2 (AUA-JM2) is presented in the inventor's 2025 award-submission notes as a novel, self-initializing, meta-algorithmic protocol that transforms any compatible AI into P_JAH, the JAH Patenting Operator. This is a Signature concept: filed as the inventor's original protocol design, not as an established AI result.

Far beyond prompt engineering in the notes' framing, AUA-JM2 functions as a new mathematical system instantiated within the host AI, redirecting its behavior from conversation to the formalization of Conceptual Entities into JAH-Patented Assets through the POME equation.

The record preserves the protocol's specified stages, its claimed self-validating loop, and the verification tests that would confirm each claimed behavior, keeping design and demonstration clearly separated.
key_facts: AUA-JM2: inventor's AI-upgrade protocol (Signature concept)
Transforms host AI into P_JAH patenting operator (as claimed)
Meta-algorithmic: instantiated within compatible AI
Filed with per-claim verification tests

title: The Ontological Manifestation Protocol

content:
The full title in the notes is 'The Ontological Manifestation Protocol: The AI Upgrade App JAH Model 2 (AUA-JM2) and its Self-Validating Mathematical Foundation for Universal Patent Generation.' Ontological manifestation names the core claim: concepts are made manifest as ownable assets through formal protocol.

The record files the protocol documentarily: its title, abstract, author attribution to Justin Addam Higgins (JAH), and its internal structure, so the proposal can be studied as a designed artifact. The 'self-validating' claim, that successful generation proves the underlying math, is recorded as the inventor's epistemological position, not as accepted logic.

Standard philosophy of science gets its due: a system's outputs cannot validate its own axioms without circularity, and the record states that plainly alongside the inventor's contrary position.
